safetycase.title: Supports Safety Case
safetycase.remarks: Specifies whether this regulation supports a safety case. If this check box is selected, this regulation supports a safety case. If this check box is cleared, this regulation does not support a safety case.

country.title: Regulatory Country
country.remarks: The country of the issuing authority.

subsection.title: Regulation Sub-Section
subsection.remarks: The subsection of the regulation number for this regulation. The Regulation Number field must contain a value.

insurancereq.title: Insurance Requirements
insurancereq.remarks: Specifies whether insurance requirements apply to this regulation. If the check box is selected, insurance requirements apply. If the check box is cleared, insurance requirements do not apply.

num.title: Regulation Number
num.remarks: The alphanumeric value that identifies the regulation (for example, DOT178).

techauthid.title: Technical Authority
techauthid.remarks: The technical authority who is associated with the regulation record. You can assign a person as a technical authority on the Details tab of the People application.

ownergroup.title: Owner Group
ownergroup.remarks: The group that has responsibility for this regulation. The owner group is most likely the contact for questions concerning this regulation and has responsibility for keeping the regulation up to date. If the regulation is workflow enabled, the owner group is probably the group that is used for approval of changes to this regulation.

type.title: Regulation Type
type.remarks: The type of regulation. Valid values are in the PLUSGREGTYPE domain.

revisionby.title: Revised By
revisionby.remarks: The person who revised the regulation record.

safetycaseref.title: Safety Case Reference
safetycaseref.remarks: The reference for the safety case that this regulation supports.

owner.title: Regulation Owner
owner.remarks: The person who has responsibility for this regulation. The owner is most likely the contact for questions concerning this regulation and has responsibility for keeping the regulation up to date. If the regulation is workflow enabled, the owner is probably the person used for approval of changes to this regulation.

externalsysref.title: External System Reference
externalsysref.remarks: The reference number used by an external system to identify this regulation.

appliesto.title: Applies To
appliesto.remarks: The type of work to which the regulation applies. Valid values are in the PLUSGREGAPPLIESTO domain.

safetycritelement.title: Safety Critical Element
safetycritelement.remarks: A reference to any element that is critical to safety and that is associated with a regulation. A performance standard that regulates the emission of hazardous substances can be a type of critical-safety reference.

revisionnum.title: Revision
revisionnum.remarks: The revision number of the regulation record. Indicates how many times a regulation record has been revised.

expirationdate.title: Expiration Date
expirationdate.remarks: If an expiration date applies, the expiration date of this regulation.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: The date and time when the regulation was created or was changed through the Change Status action.

authority.title: Regulatory Authority
authority.remarks: The name of the issuing regulatory authority.

revisiondate.title: Revision Date
revisiondate.remarks: The date when the regulation record was revised.

validfrom.title: Valid From
validfrom.remarks: The date from which the regulation is valid.

region.title: Regulatory Region
region.remarks: The state or region of the issuing authority.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The status of the regulation. When you create a new regulation, the application assigns it a status of DRAFT.
